import.issue.apply_failed.explanation: Import preview/result row detail: the row passed checks but could not be saved. Sits in a narrow table cell.

import.issue.barcode_duplicate.explanation:
Import row detail: the same barcode is on two or more rows of this import.

Placeholders:
- %s: the barcode that appears on more than one row

import.issue.barcode_invalid.explanation: Import row detail: a barcode on the row contains characters a barcode may not have (only letters, digits and hyphens are allowed).

import.issue.barcode_not_accepted.explanation:
Import row detail: the till's barcode settings (enabled barcode types) reject this barcode.

Placeholders:
- %s: the barcode the till refused

import.issue.barcode_taken.explanation:
Import row detail: the barcode is already used by a different item in the catalog, so the row is not applied.

Placeholders:
- %s: the barcode that already belongs to another item

import.issue.category_level_invalid.explanation: Import row detail: one level of the row's category path is empty, too long or has forbidden characters.

import.issue.category_too_deep.explanation:
Import row detail: the category path has more nested levels than the till supports.

Placeholders:
- %s: the maximum number of category levels allowed (a number)

import.issue.external_id_duplicate.explanation: Import row detail: the other system's record ID appears on two or more rows of this import. 'ID' is the product's ID in the previous system.

import.issue.external_id_invalid.explanation: Import row detail: the row has no ID from the other system, or it is too long or has forbidden characters.

import.issue.item_already_matched.explanation: Import row detail: an earlier row of this same import already matched the catalog item this row would update.

import.issue.item_linked_elsewhere.explanation:
Import row detail: the catalog item that matches this row by barcode or SKU was already imported from a different record of the other system.

Placeholders:
- %s: the other system's record ID the item is already linked to

import.issue.name_invalid.explanation: Import row detail: the product name is missing, too long or has forbidden characters.

import.issue.price_invalid.explanation: Import row detail: the price is missing, negative or implausibly large.

import.issue.row_not_object.explanation: Import row detail: the importer sent something for this row that is not a product record.

import.issue.row_not_single_object.explanation: Import row detail: the importer sent more than one product record in one row.

import.issue.sku_duplicate.explanation: Import row detail: the same SKU (stock-keeping code) is on two or more rows of this import.

import.issue.sku_invalid.explanation: Import row detail: the SKU (stock-keeping code) is too long or has forbidden characters.

import.issue.sku_taken.explanation: Import row detail: the SKU (stock-keeping code) is already used by a different item in the catalog, so the row is not applied.

import.issue.stock_out_of_range.explanation: Import row detail: the stock quantity is not a usable number or is implausibly large.

import.issue.too_many_barcodes.explanation:
Import row detail: the row lists more barcodes for one product than the till allows.

Placeholders:
- %s: the maximum number of barcodes allowed on one item (a number)

import.issue.vat_out_of_range.explanation: Import row detail: the tax rate is below 0 or above 100 percent.

import.system.ask_manager.explanation: Shown on the import page's 'From another till system' section to a user who may not install plugins or edit their settings: who to ask instead. Also shown when no importer is installed.

import.system.busy.explanation: Busy message while the till fetches products from the shop's previous till system through an importer plugin (can take minutes).

import.system.change.active.explanation: Name of a changed field in an import preview row: whether the product is active (sellable). One word, lower case, joined into a list.

import.system.change.barcode.explanation: Name of a changed field in an import preview row: the product's barcode. Lower case, joined into a list.

import.system.change.category.explanation: Name of a changed field in an import preview row: the product's category. Lower case, joined into a list.

import.system.change.name.explanation: Name of a changed field in an import preview row: the product's name. Lower case, joined into a list.

import.system.change.price.explanation: Name of a changed field in an import preview row: the product's selling price. Lower case, joined into a list.

import.system.change.stock.explanation: Name of a changed field in an import preview row: the product's stock count. Lower case, joined into a list.

import.system.change.vat.explanation: Name of a changed field in an import preview row: the product's VAT rate. Lower case, joined into a list.

import.system.changes.explanation:
Import preview row detail listing which fields of an existing product the import would change. Sits in a narrow table cell: keep it short and lower case.

Placeholders:
- %s: comma-separated list of changed field names, e.g. 'price, stock'

import.system.col.detail.explanation: Column heading in the import preview table: what changes or what is wrong with the row.

import.system.col.name.explanation: Column heading in the import preview table: the product name.

import.system.col.result.explanation: Column heading in the import preview table: whether the row is new, updated, unchanged or has an issue.

import.system.col.row.explanation: Column heading in the import preview table: the row number from the importer.

import.system.commit_done.explanation: Message shown when an import from another till system has finished and the products are saved; also shown above a warning when some rows had issues.

import.system.connection.explanation: Accessible label read by screen readers (not visible text) for the list of an importer plugin's secret keys (API key and secret), each shown only as set or not set.

import.system.count.issues.explanation: Count label in an import result: rows that could not be imported because of a problem.

import.system.count.new.explanation: Count label in an import result: products that will be (or were) added.

import.system.count.unchanged.explanation: Count label in an import result: products that already match and are left as they are.

import.system.count.updated.explanation: Count label in an import result: existing products that will be (or were) changed.

import.system.error.bad_answer.explanation: Error when the importer plugin's reply can't be read; nothing was saved.

import.system.error.declined.explanation:
Error when the importer plugin stopped and gave a reason, for example wrong API keys.

Placeholders:
- %s: the reason the importer plugin gave, in its own words

import.system.error.declined_silent.explanation: Error when the importer plugin stopped without giving a reason; points the user to the connection settings.

import.system.error.failed.explanation: Error when the import could not be completed for an unexpected reason; nothing was saved.

import.system.error.no_entities.explanation: Error when the importer plugin has not been granted permission to add products.

import.system.error.no_response.explanation: Error when the importer plugin did not answer in time, usually because the till is offline.

import.system.error.not_found.explanation: Error when the chosen importer plugin was removed while the page was open.

import.system.error.partial.explanation:
Error when an import stopped part-way; tells the user how many products were saved and that running it again is safe.

Placeholders:
- %d: number of products saved before the import stopped

import.system.error.preview_failed.explanation: Error when the import preview could not be built.

import.system.error.refused.explanation: Error when the till rejected the product rows the importer plugin sent; nothing was saved.

import.system.get_importer.explanation: Link to the plugin store's import category, shown when no importer plugin is installed.

import.system.help.explanation: Explanation at the top of the 'From another till system' import section: what an importer plugin does, that preview saves nothing and that re-running is safe.

import.system.none.explanation: Empty state when no importer plugin for another till system is installed; says what to do next.

import.system.plugin_message.explanation:
Shows a message the importer plugin returned, for example the name of the connected account.

Placeholders:
- %s: the message text the importer plugin returned

import.system.preview.explanation: Button that fetches products from the other till system and shows what would be imported, without saving anything.

import.system.preview_done.explanation: Message above the import preview: nothing is saved until the user presses Import.

import.system.run_again.explanation: Button that repeats an import that stopped part-way; already imported products are not duplicated.

import.system.samples.explanation: Heading above the table of example rows from the import preview.

import.system.settings_link.explanation: Link to the importer plugin's settings page, where the shop enters its API key and secret.

import.system.title.explanation: Heading of the import page section that imports products from another till system through an installed importer plugin.

import.welcome.system.action.explanation: Button on the import page's welcome card that opens the 'From another till system' section.

import.welcome.system.body.explanation: Text on the import page's welcome card explaining importing straight from the shop's old till system account, with a preview first.

import.welcome.system.title.explanation: Title of the import page's welcome card for importing from another till system.
